# `typeof`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
typeof(expr)
```

Return DDL-formatted type string for the data type of the input.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `misc_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- typeof, example 1
> SELECT typeof(1);
int
```

```sql
-- typeof, example 2
> SELECT typeof(array(1));
array<int>
```
